reuse.why: Folds the three average actions into one helper, but setAllCategoriesAverage re-inlines the average-and-sign logic of the existing setNMonthAvg instead of calling it, and copyPreviousMonth does not use the new category selection.

duplication.why: The eligibility rule (hidden, group hidden, saved template) is written twice, once as SQL in getMonthActionCategories and once as a JS predicate in copyPreviousMonth, and the income sign flip is duplicated with setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: Selection helper and shared average action live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; it also quietly changes set6/12MonthAvg from fire-and-forget setNMonthAvg to awaited setBudget and adds an unused group_hidden column type.

maintainability.why: Better than three copied queries, but a future change to the skip rule must be made in both the SQL WHERE and the copyPreviousMonth condition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setAllCategoriesAverage in budget/actions.ts reimplements setNMonthAvg (getCategoryAverage + sign flip + setBudget) instead of calling it.

disguised_duplication.where: The month-action eligibility rule appears as a SQL WHERE (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0 AND c.goal_def IS NULL) in getMonthActionCategories and reshaped as a JS condition (hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1 || goal_def !== null) in copyPreviousMonth.

one_place.where: setZero and the average actions use getMonthActionCategories, but copyPreviousMonth decides the same rule separately on getBudgetData rows.
